result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but there are several visual defects: truncated text on a carousel card, a partially rendered filter chip with no visible label, and the bottom restaurant card being cut off/overlapped by the tab bar without any visual affordance.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off at the screen edge without an ellipsis, making the name unreadable and looking broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis within the card bounds, and ensure the card itself is clearly peeking to indicate horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: A filter chip after 'Healthy' is partially visible at the right edge but shows no label text at all, appearing as an empty gray pill fragment.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/peek amount so the next chip shows at least part of its label, or add a fade/gradient edge to signal more content.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card at the bottom is abruptly clipped by the bottom navigation bar, hiding its name, rating, and delivery info with no scroll affordance or fade.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scroll container equal to the tab bar height, or use a translucent/gradient tab bar so content is not hard-clipped.

issues.description: Delivery fee and metadata text (e.g., '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min') uses light gray that may have insufficient contrast against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Darken secondary text color to meet WCAG AA contrast ratio of 4.5:1.

issues.description: The profile avatar in the top right appears as an empty gray circle with only a red notification dot, suggesting the avatar image or initials failed to load.
issues.suggestion: Provide a fallback avatar (user initials or a person icon) when no profile image is available.
